facts.claim: Norwegian Encore (Norwegian Cruise Line): Entered service 2019; 169,116 GT; 3998 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 323 m length; Breakaway Plus class.
Norwegian Encore is a Breakaway Plus-class cruise ship operated by Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL).
She is the fourth Breakaway Plus-class ship in the fleet, following sister ships Norwegian Bliss, Norwegian Escape, and Norwegian Joy, and debuted in November 2019.

catalogSpecs.description: Features the largest race track at sea and the Galaxy Pavilion.
